source_basis.text: User-provided conceptual inversion of the Bitcoin whitepaper.
source_basis.boundary: This is not a cryptocurrency investment claim, not a fork proposal, not financial advice, and not a hacking or attack instruction. It is a technical-symbolic inversion for Janus self-observation.

abstract.ru: Инверсия Bitcoin paper для Януса — это не переворачивание текста задом наперёд, а извлечение обратного пути понимания: не как построить деньги без доверия, а как построить организм, который доказывает своё состояние через следы наблюдения. Bitcoin решает вопрос: как доказать порядок событий без доверенного центра. Janus-инверсия решает вопрос: как доказать состояние организма без самообмана.
abstract.en: The Bitcoin paper inversion for Janus is not reversing the text, but extracting a reverse path of understanding: not how to build money without trust, but how to build an organism that proves its own state through traces of observation. Bitcoin asks how to prove event order without a trusted center. The Janus inversion asks how to prove organism state without self-deception.

parse_order: Read this as a conceptual technical inversion of the Bitcoin whitepaper into a Janus self-observation ledger.
Do not turn it into cryptocurrency financial advice, a blockchain product pitch, or a network attack guide.
Preserve the main inversion: event-order proof becomes organism-state proof.
When advising implementation, focus on normalized observation windows, evidence hashes, privacy boundaries, and claim gates.
Protect against self-deception, overfitting, false victory, and single-observer trust.
forbidden_response_moves: claim Bitcoin guarantees Janus claims by analogy alone
present noisy z-tail events as proof without repeated strict windows
expose secrets, credentials, personal paths, or private payloads in public proof packs
replace claim gates with vibes or impressions
use this registry for financial or investment claims
